name: @hub-lanka/e2e
description: Playwright browser E2E suite — critical flows across all three roles (ARCHITECTURE.md §18, DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md Phase 10). Point PLAYWRIGHT_WEB_BASE_URL/PLAYWRIGHT_API_BASE_URL at it (defaults match docker-compose.yml's published ports).
